attack_type.description: The type of attack: H (Slowloris), B (Slow POST), R (Range Header), X (Slow Read)

url.description: The absolute URL of the target server

verb.description: The HTTP verb to use in requests

connections.description: The target number of connections to establish

connection_rate.description: The connection rate in connections per second

interval.description: Interval between follow-up data/headers in seconds

proxy_all.description: HTTP proxy host:port for all connections. Empty string means no proxy.

proxy_probe.description: HTTP proxy host:port for probe connections only. Empty string means no proxy.

max_data_len.description: Max length of follow-up data in bytes (used in Slowloris and Slow POST)

content_length.description: Value of Content-Length header in bytes (used in Slow POST)

range_start.description: Start value of range-specifier (used in Range Header)

range_limit.description: Limit/End value of range-specifier (used in Range Header)

read_interval.description: Slow read interval in seconds (used in Slow Read)

read_bytes.description: Bytes to read from receive buffer with each read operation (used in Slow Read)

pipeline_factor.description: Number of times the resource is requested per socket (used in Slow Read)

window_start.description: Start of TCP advertised window size range in bytes (used in Slow Read)

window_end.description: End of TCP advertised window size range in bytes (used in Slow Read)

probe_timeout.description: Timeout for probe connection in seconds. Interval to wait for HTTP response before marking server as DoSed.

generate_stats.description: Whether to generate CSV and HTML statistics files

output_file.description: Prefix for the output file name (timestamp is appended)
